args:
set -e
echo "[runtime] Sourcing ROS 2 + base workspace..."
source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash
source /opt/base_ws/install/setup.bash

echo "[runtime] Sourcing overlay workspace..."
source /opt/overlay/install/setup.bash

# ── Workaround for ros2-overlay-pack <= 1.0.x ──
# pip pulls nvidia-cuda-runtime-cu13 + nvidia-cudnn-cu13 etc.
# as transitive deps of ultralytics/transformers. Their .so
# files install under /opt/overlay/python-deps/nvidia/<lib>/
# as a SHARED namespace package, so deleting the .dist-info
# dirs alone is not enough — we must wipe the nvidia/ dir
# itself. The Jetson PyTorch wheel does NOT depend on these
# (it links libcuda from /usr/local/cuda/lib64 inherited
# from ros2-base).
echo "[runtime] Stripping nvidia-cu13 datacenter libs from overlay..."
rm -rf /opt/overlay/python-deps/nvidia      2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf /opt/overlay/python-deps/cuda_toolkit 2>/dev/null || true
# Also remove any *.dist-info / *.libs folders that referenced them
find /opt/overlay/python-deps -maxdepth 1 -type d \
  \( -name "nvidia_*" -o -name "cuda_toolkit*" \) \
  -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
echo "[runtime] Remaining python-deps top-level (nvidia/cuda):"
ls /opt/overlay/python-deps 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "nvidia|cuda" || \
  echo "  (none — clean)"

# PYTHONPATH for the overlay's pip --target site-packages
# (PyTorch, transformers, accelerate, ultralytics, etc.)
export PYTHONPATH="/opt/overlay/python-deps:${PYTHONPATH}"

# LD_LIBRARY_PATH for the system libs we staged in the overlay
# (libasound, libportaudio, libsndfile — needed by librosa,
# sounddevice). Append to existing path (set in ros2-base ENV).
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/opt/overlay/system-libs:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"

echo "[runtime] Environment summary:"
echo "  PYTHONPATH=${PYTHONPATH}"
echo "  LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
echo "  HF_HOME=${HF_HOME}"
echo ""

echo "[runtime] Starting resource_monitor..."
python3 /opt/scripts/resource_monitor.py &
RESMON_PID=$!

echo "[runtime] Starting camera_driver..."
ros2 run camera_driver_pkg camera_driver --ros-args \
  -p device:=${CAMERA_DEVICE} \
  -p width:=${CAMERA_WIDTH} \
  -p height:=${CAMERA_HEIGHT} \
  -p fps:=${CAMERA_FPS} \
  -p frame_id:=${CAMERA_FRAME_ID} \
  -p synthetic_mode:=${CAMERA_SYNTHETIC_MODE} \
  -p image_topic:=${IMAGE_TOPIC} &
CAMERA_PID=$!

sleep ${YOLO_START_DELAY}
echo "[runtime] Starting yolo_detector..."
ros2 run yolo_detector_pkg yolo_detector --ros-args \
  -p model_path:=${YOLO_MODEL_PATH} \
  -p conf:=${YOLO_CONF} \
  -p image_topic:=${IMAGE_TOPIC} \
  -p detections_topic:=${DETECTIONS_TOPIC} \
  -p debug_image_topic:=${DEBUG_IMAGE_TOPIC} \
  -p publish_debug_image:=${YOLO_PUBLISH_DEBUG} \
  -p publish_metrics:=${YOLO_PUBLISH_METRICS} \
  -p latency_topic:=${LATENCY_TOPIC} \
  -p inference_topic:=${INFERENCE_TOPIC} \
  -p filter_classes:="\"${YOLO_FILTER_CLASSES}\"" &
YOLO_PID=$!

if [ "${LLAVA_ENABLED}" = "true" ]; then
  sleep ${LLAVA_START_DELAY}
  echo "[runtime] Starting llava_node..."
  ros2 run llava_pkg llava_node --ros-args \
    -p model_id:=${LLAVA_MODEL_ID} \
    -p image_topic:=${IMAGE_TOPIC} \
    -p detection_topic:=${DETECTIONS_TOPIC} \
    -p trigger_topic:=${LLAVA_TRIGGER_TOPIC} \
    -p response_topic:=${LLAVA_RESPONSE_TOPIC} \
    -p latency_topic:=${LLAVA_LATENCY_TOPIC} \
    -p inference_topic:=${LLAVA_INFERENCE_TOPIC} \
    -p trigger_on_yolo:=${LLAVA_TRIGGER_ON_YOLO} \
    -p yolo_trigger_interval_s:=$(printf "%.1f" "${LLAVA_YOLO_INTERVAL_S}") \
    -p max_new_tokens:=${LLAVA_MAX_TOKENS} \
    -p load_in_4bit:=${LLAVA_LOAD_4BIT} \
    -p hf_cache_dir:=/opt/overlay/huggingface_cache &
  LLAVA_PID=$!
fi

if [ "${VOXTRAL_ENABLED}" = "true" ]; then
  echo "[runtime] Starting voxtral_node..."
  ros2 run voxtral_pkg voxtral_node --ros-args \
    -p audio_mode:=${VOXTRAL_AUDIO_MODE} \
    -p model_id:=${VOXTRAL_MODEL_ID} \
    -p command_topic:=${VOICE_COMMAND_TOPIC} \
    -p transcript_topic:=${VOICE_TRANSCRIPT_TOPIC} \
    -p response_topic:=${VOICE_RESPONSE_TOPIC} \
    -p llava_trigger_topic:=${LLAVA_TRIGGER_TOPIC} \
    -p llava_response_topic:=${LLAVA_RESPONSE_TOPIC} \
    -p latency_topic:=${VOICE_LATENCY_TOPIC} \
    -p hf_cache_dir:=/opt/overlay/huggingface_cache &
  VOXTRAL_PID=$!
fi

echo "[runtime] All nodes launched. Waiting for any to exit..."
wait -n ${CAMERA_PID} ${YOLO_PID} ${RESMON_PID} ${LLAVA_PID:-} ${VOXTRAL_PID:-}
echo "[runtime] One process exited — pod will restart"
exit 1
containers.name: overlay-runtime

command:
FULLNAME="overlay-pattern"
NS="ros2exp"
OVERLAY_SVC="${FULLNAME}-overlay-server.${NS}.svc.cluster.local"
DASH_SVC="${FULLNAME}-dashboard-0.${FULLNAME}-dashboard-peers.${NS}.svc.cluster.local"
echo "[init] Waiting for overlay-server DNS: $OVERLAY_SVC"
until nslookup "$OVERLAY_SVC" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
  echo "[init]   $OVERLAY_SVC not resolvable yet, retrying in 3s..."
  sleep 3
done
echo "[init]   $OVERLAY_SVC resolved"
if [ -n "$DASH_SVC" ]; then
  echo "[init] Waiting for dashboard DNS: $DASH_SVC"
  until nslookup "$DASH_SVC" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    echo "[init]   $DASH_SVC not resolvable yet, retrying in 3s..."
    sleep 3
  done
  echo "[init]   $DASH_SVC resolved"
fi
echo "[init] All DNS targets resolved — proceeding to overlay sync"
initContainers.name: wait-for-services

command:
set -eo pipefail
# Install curl (alpine doesn't include it by default)
apk add --no-cache curl >/dev/null

FULLNAME="overlay-pattern"
NS="ros2exp"
VERSION="1.0.0"
OVERLAY_SVC="${FULLNAME}-overlay-server.${NS}.svc.cluster.local"
PORT=80
TARGET=/opt/overlay
TIMEOUT=1800

# Helper: HTTP HEAD probe — returns 0 if URL is reachable with 200.
probe_url() {
  curl -fsI --max-time 5 "$1" -o /dev/null
}

# Helper: poll a URL until it becomes reachable. Used in
# overlay.pipeline=true mode where the pre-install Job runs in
# parallel with this init container, so a layer tarball may not
# exist yet at this container's start time.
wait_for_url() {
  local url=$1
  local label=${2:-$url}
  local max_wait=${TIMEOUT}
  local waited=0
  while ! probe_url "${url}"; do
    if [ "${waited}" -ge "${max_wait}" ]; then
      echo "[sync] FATAL: ${label} did not become available within ${max_wait} s"
      exit 1
    fi
    sleep 5
    waited=$((waited + 5))
    if [ $((waited % 30)) -eq 0 ]; then
      echo "[sync]   still waiting for ${label} (${waited}/${max_wait}s)"
    fi
  done
}

mkdir -p "${TARGET}"
# ── Legacy single-tarball mode ─────────────────────────────────
URL="http://${OVERLAY_SVC}:${PORT}/overlay/${VERSION}.tar"
echo "[sync] Source: ${URL}"
echo "[sync] Target: ${TARGET}"
if [ -f "${TARGET}/install/setup.bash" ]; then
  echo "[sync] Overlay already extracted, skipping download"
  ls -la "${TARGET}/"
  exit 0
fi
echo "[sync] Waiting for overlay-server + tarball availability..."
wait_for_url "${URL}" "overlay tarball"
echo "[sync] Server OK. Downloading + extracting tarball..."
curl -fSL --max-time ${TIMEOUT} "${URL}" \
  | tar -xf - -C "${TARGET}"

echo "[sync] Extraction complete. Contents:"
ls -la "${TARGET}/"
echo "[sync] Sizes:"
du -sh "${TARGET}"/install        2>/dev/null || true
du -sh "${TARGET}"/python-deps    2>/dev/null || true
du -sh "${TARGET}"/huggingface_cache 2>/dev/null || true
du -sh "${TARGET}"/models         2>/dev/null || true
du -sh "${TARGET}"/system-libs    2>/dev/null || true
echo "[sync] Done."
initContainers.name: overlay-sync

command:
FULLNAME="overlay-pattern"
NS="ros2exp"
RUNTIME_PEER="${FULLNAME}-0.${FULLNAME}-peers.${NS}.svc.cluster.local"
echo "[init] Waiting for DDS peer DNS: $RUNTIME_PEER"
until nslookup "$RUNTIME_PEER" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
  echo "[init]   $RUNTIME_PEER not resolvable yet, retrying in 3s..."
  sleep 3
done
echo "[init]   $RUNTIME_PEER resolved"
GRACE=60
echo "[init] Runtime DNS resolved — waiting ${GRACE}s for camera/YOLO/LLaVA/Voxtral to finish loading models"
sleep "$GRACE"
echo "[init] Ready to start rosbridge"
initContainers.name: wait-for-peers
